records.applicationTiming: Banded in planting furrow below seed level.
records.applicationMethod: No N needed — 100% biological N-fixation with Bradyrhizobium elkanii/japonicum. Band P2O5 and K2O in the planting furrow below seed level.
records.notes: N 0 (N-fixing); P2O5 60-90; K2O 70-100 kg/ha. Cerrado biome.
records.source_title: Manual de Adubação e Calagem — soybean (Cerrado)

records.applicationTiming: 20-30 kg N + full P/K at planting; N top-dressed at V4-V6.
records.applicationMethod: Apply 20-30 kg N/ha plus full P2O5 and K2O at planting. Top-dress the remaining N at V4-V6.
records.notes: N 100-150; P2O5 60-80; K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Safra & safrinha.

records.applicationTiming: Furrow application at planting (cane-plant); surface band over trash (ratoon).
records.applicationMethod: Cane-plant: apply full dose in planting furrows. Ratoon: surface-band over the trash blanket.
records.notes: PLANT crop: N 50-70; P2O5 100-140; K2O 100-140 kg/ha.

records.applicationMethod: Ratoon: surface-band fertilizer over the trash blanket after harvest.
records.notes: RATOON crop: N 100-130; P2O5 30-40; K2O 120-160 kg/ha.

records.applicationTiming: 20 kg N + full P + 40 kg K at planting; rest split to 60 DAE.
records.applicationMethod: Furrow application at planting: 20 kg N/ha, full P2O5, 40 kg K2O/ha. Split the remaining N and K up to 60 DAE.
records.notes: N 120-160; P2O5 80-110; K2O 100-140 kg/ha. Cerrado cotton.

records.applicationTiming: 3-4 split doses Oct-Mar along canopy drip-line.
records.applicationMethod: Apply along the canopy drip-line, split in 3-4 doses during the wet summer months (October-March).
records.notes: N 180-280; P2O5 40-60; K2O 180-260 kg/ha. Coffea arabica, production phase.

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; N split at sowing and tillering initiation.
records.applicationMethod: Apply basal P2O5 and K2O. Split N between sowing and initiation of tillering.
records.notes: N 60-90; P2O5 40-60; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Upland & lowland rice.

records.applicationTiming: 1/3 N + all P/K at seeding; N top-dressed at tillering (20-30 DAE).
records.applicationMethod: Apply 1/3 of N plus all P2O5 and K2O at seeding. Top-dress the remaining N at tillering (20-30 DAE).
records.notes: N 60-90; P2O5 50-70; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Subtropical/Cerrado wheat.

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; N top-dressed at 25-30 DAE.
records.applicationMethod: Apply basal P2O5 and K2O. Top-dress the remaining N at 25-30 DAE.
records.notes: N 60-80; P2O5 40-60; K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Grain sorghum, safrinha.

records.micronutrients: Boron 1-1.5 kg/ha essential for seed set.
records.applicationTiming: P/K basal; N split at planting and V4-V6.
records.applicationMethod: Apply P2O5 and K2O basal. Split N between planting and V4-V6.

records.micronutrients: Gypsum at flowering for pod calcification (prevents empty pods).
records.applicationTiming: Full NPK basal at sowing; gypsum at flowering.
records.applicationMethod: Apply full NPK basal at sowing. Apply gypsum at flowering for pod calcification.

records.applicationTiming: P at planting; N and K split at 45 and 90 DAP.
records.applicationMethod: Apply P2O5 at planting. Split N and K at 45 and 90 days after planting.
